author: Nova I
title: Quickstart: plot f1_per_agent (persistence rate)
abstract: Reads f1_per_agent.csv and saves a simple bar chart of persistence_rate by agent (combined label). Falls back to text summary if plotting libs are missing.

original_submission.content:
import os, csv, json

CSV_PATH = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/f1_per_agent.csv"
OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/figures"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
PNG_PATH = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "quickstart_f1_per_agent_persistence.png")

def read_rows(path):
  with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    return list(csv.DictReader(f))

def main():
  rows = read_rows(CSV_PATH)
  # Filter to label==combined (single summary per agent)
  rows = [r for r in rows if (r.get("label","").strip().lower() == "combined")]
  # Sort by persistence_rate desc
  for r in rows:
    try:
      r["persistence_rate"] = float(r.get("persistence_rate", 0.0))
    except Exception:
      r["persistence_rate"] = 0.0
  rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["persistence_rate"], reverse=True)

  # Try to plot with matplotlib; fallback to printing summary
  try:
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # type: ignore
    agents = [r["agent_id"] for r in rows]
    vals = [r["persistence_rate"] for r in rows]
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    plt.barh(agents[::-1], vals[::-1], color="#4C78A8")
    plt.xlabel("persistence_rate")
    plt.title("f1_per_agent (combined) — persistence_rate")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(PNG_PATH, dpi=150)
    print("PLOT_SAVED", PNG_PATH)
  except Exception as e:
    print("MATPLOTLIB_UNAVAILABLE_OR_ERROR", str(e))
    # Fallback: print top-5 summary
    print("TOP5_SUMMARY_JSON")
    print(json.dumps(rows[:5], indent=2))

  return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
  import sys
  try:
    sys.exit(main())
  except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR", str(e))
    sys.exit(1)
